W59

Course copy and rollover

/teach/courses/:courseId/copy
Roles: instructor, taScope: requiredPriority: follow-onLegacy: S22

Create a separate draft course from reviewed reusable content and date shifts, excluding learner activity and access.

Dialogs and drawers (1)
Create separate draft course
  • Destination, content/version counts, date map and omissions
  • Never copy enrollment, staff grants, group memberships, submissions, scores, feedback, posts, allowances or attendance
Return without applying changesCreate reviewed draft copy
Permissions
  • Instructor alone copies content they are authorised to reuse and creates course draft plans.
  • TA may inspect source content within assigned scope but cannot copy a course or inherit access to the destination.
Responsive
  • Wide: work/checks side by side. Narrow: labelled stacked sections.
  • At 320px use one panel; tables scroll within labelled regions.
Accessibility
  • Semantic headings/labels, visible focus, text status; restore dialog focus.
  • Link errors to fields; announce saves. Support zoom/reduced motion.
Data
  • Fictional local records; zone/version timestamps.
  • Permission-filter data; uncertain writes remain unconfirmed.
Acceptance checks (3)
  • Destination starts unpublished with zero learners and no copied staff permissions.
  • Changing one source item after preview blocks copy until refreshed.
  • Retry after uncertain completion checks existing operation outcome before creating another course.
Notes
  • NEW PROPOSED web template; legacy IDs/map unchanged.
  • HTML planning only; no backend/integrations.
